# Tin tức nổi bật về Việt Nam

## Kinh tế & Thương mại
- Ngành thương mại điện tử Việt Nam tiếp tục phát triển mạnh mẽ, thu hút đầu tư nước ngoài nhờ dân số trẻ, thu nhập tăng và vai trò trung tâm xuất khẩu thương mại điện tử xuyên biên giới trong khu vực. - [vietnam-briefing.com](https://www.vietnam-briefing.com/news/vietnam-e-commerce-sector-2026.html)

## Doanh nghiệp lớn
- Vingroup đang đẩy mạnh chiến lược mở rộng quốc tế, bao gồm thỏa thuận xây dựng “Vietnam Town” tại Tashkent (Uzbekistan), cùng các dự án phát triển đô thị thông minh và linh kiện robot. - [abcnews.com](https://abcnews.com/Business/wireStory/vietnams-biggest-company-vingroup-expands-overseas-home-market-135178833)

## Năng lượng & Hàng không
- Hội đồng Ngũ cốc & Sản phẩm Sinh học Hoa Kỳ (USGBC) thảo luận về tiềm năng của ethanol làm nhiên liệu hàng không thay thế tại hội nghị ở Đà Nẵng. - [ethanolproducer.com](https://ethanolproducer.com/articles/vietnam-usgbc-discusses-ethanols-capability-as-an-alternative-aviation-fuel)

## Quan hệ quốc tế
- Việt Nam chuẩn bị đón tàu sân bay Mỹ thăm cảng, cho thấy sự phát triển tích cực trong quan hệ song phương bất chấp những biến động thương mại và quốc tế. - [scmp.com](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3362219/vietnam-host-us-aircraft-carrier-despite-trumps-tariffs-iran-war-chaos)

items.summary: Vietnam Briefing is one of five regional publications under the Asia Briefing brand. It is supported by Dezan Shira & Associates, a pan-Asia, multi-disciplinary professional services firm that assists foreign investors throughout Asia, including through offices in Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, and Da Nang in Vietnam. Dezan Shira & Associates also maintains offices or has alliance partners assisting foreign investors in China, Hong Kong SAR, Indonesia, Singapore, Malaysia, Mongolia, Dubai [...] With a young population, rising disposable incomes, and a rapidly expanding middle class, Vietnam continues to stand out as one of Southeast Asia’s most attractive destinations for e-commerce investment. Its growing role as a regional e-commerce export hub further strengthens the country’s long-term outlook, positioning Vietnam as a market to watch in 2026 and beyond. [...] Vietnam is also emerging as a regional hub for cross-border e-commerce, supported by its competitive manufacturing base, digital transformation, and export-oriented economy. At the Amazon Global Selling Conference 2025, Amazon identified Vietnam as one of its fastest-growing sourcing markets, citing strong growth in Vietnamese product listings and brand-registered sellers.

items.title: Vietnam's biggest company, Vingroup, expands overseas ...
items.summary:
In Uzbekistan, Vingroup signed an agreement in December to build a “Vietnam Town” in its capital, the ancient Silk Road city of Tashkent. In Central Asia’s largest metropolis, it envisions a development modeled on its signature projects in Vietnam, combining homes, shopping centers, schools, hospitals and EV charging stations.

Other projects include tourism ventures like a zoo in India and smart-city projects in Africa to plans to develop motors and moving parts needed for robots in Germany. [...] Like China before it, Vietnam wants to build globally competitive companies now that the export-led model that has lifted the country out of poverty is, in the words of Communist Party General Secretary To Lam, under “unprecedented strain.” [...] Vietnam stepped up its expansion into other global markets after tariffs imposed by U.S. President Donald Trump exposed the risks of relying too heavily on a handful of export destinations. The U.S. accounts for over 30% of Vietnam's exports.

Central Asia has become one focus. Trade with Uzbekistan reached $202 million in 2024, up 26.5% from a year earlier, while Vietnam elevated ties with Kazakhstan to a strategic partnership in 2025.
